name: Nacho and Nacha
description: A pair of Ignacio free-electron lasers at the Dawnsire's prow, used to harvest power from supervoids and as weapons; they bombard Susur Secundi.

timeline.summary: Nacha fires a laser pulse train across two hundred lightseconds at Susur Secundi.
Nacho maps the defenses from Nacha's shot and then hits the monastery being built above Susur Secundi.
timeline.quote: The monastery in construction above Susur Secundi jets violet plasma and lurches in its orbit.
